name: Cyclopropylmescaline
summary: Cyclopropylmescaline, AKA CPM, is a psychedelic/hallucinogenic that was produced by Alexander Shulgin. It causes visual and auditory hallucinations and is reported to have a long duration. There is limited information on this drug, caution is advised

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: CPM acts as a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor full agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a rare psychedelic, taken occasionally by people experimenting with research chemicals. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種罕見的迷幻藥，偶爾被嘗試研究化學品的人使用。它沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种罕见的迷幻药，偶尔被尝试研究化学品的人使用。它没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family can cause anxiety, panic, confusion, nausea, a fast heartbeat and raised blood pressure, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in people who are vulnerable.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同家族的迷幻藥可能造成焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、噁心、心跳加快與血壓升高，並可能在易感者身上誘發持續的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同家族的迷幻药可能造成焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、恶心、心跳加快与血压升高，并可能在易感者身上诱发持续的精神健康问题。

fact.en: It is mescaline with its middle methoxy group swapped for a cyclopropylmethoxy group. Mescaline itself was first isolated from the peyote cactus in 1897 by the German chemist Arthur Heffter.
fact.zh: 它是把仙人掌毒鹼中間的甲氧基換成環丙基甲氧基。仙人掌毒鹼本身是德國化學家亞瑟·赫夫特在 1897 年首次從烏羽玉仙人掌中分離出來的。
fact.zhHans: 它是把仙人掌毒碱中间的甲氧基换成环丙基甲氧基。仙人掌毒碱本身是德国化学家亚瑟·赫夫特在 1897 年首次从乌羽玉仙人掌中分离出来的。
